enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning to left side. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket up. Remaining still. Turning to right side. Kicking off blanket. Pulling blanket back. Moving arm. Moving leg. Breathing deeply. Snoring lightly. Sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer eggs to plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Remove toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look at phone. Check messages. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Make phone call. Restock supplies.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay at register. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Sit on bench. Check phone. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Assist with procedure. Update records. Consult with doctor. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Make phone call. Restock supplies. Attend meeting. Report to supervisor.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes.

Walk into living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Stand up and walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas.

Walk into bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm. Move leg. Breathe deeply. Snore lightly. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
